sources.title: Elephant Trunk Hill in Guilin: How to Visit
sources.content:
Elephant Trunk Hill in Guilin: Complete Content Extract

Overview
Elephant Trunk Hill is Guilin's iconic landmark, located downtown and easily accessible on foot or by car. The distinctive elephant-shaped karst mountain formation dips into the Li River and is free to visit. Over 80% of visitors include it in their itineraries.

Three Ways to Experience the Site

1. Leisurely Photo Visit (Under 2 Hours)
- Moon-in-the-Water viewing platform near Gate 2 provides the classic "elephant's trunk" photograph
- Guilin Jolie Vue Boutique Hotel's rooftop cafe offers panoramic aerial views while avoiding crowds

2. In-Depth Hiking Experience
Recommended route: Gate 1 -> Moon-in-the-Water Cave -> Summit -> Puxian Pagoda -> First Viewing Platform -> Lovers' Island -> Gate 2

Key highlights include:
- "Where the elephant's 'trunk' meets the Li River, featuring millennia-old cliff carvings"
- Puxian Pagoda at summit with Tibetan-style Buddhist architecture
- Elephant's Eye Cave for geological formations

Hiking difficulty is moderate with steep stone steps. Twenty minutes required to reach summit. Approximately 200 meters elevation gain. Families with children regularly climb on weekends.

3. Li River Bamboo Raft
Twenty-minute water perspective costs approximately $30 USD per raft (up to 4 passengers). Similar scenic views as shore-based experiences.

Best Visiting Times
Optimal Season: Autumn (September-November) offers cool, comfortable weather for climbing

Peak Hours to Avoid: After 10:00 AM when "viewing platforms become overcrowded after 10:00 AM, making quality photography difficult"

Recommended Times:
- Early morning (7:00-9:00): Fewer crowds, soft lighting, locals practicing tai chi
- Late afternoon (17:00-18:30): Sunset photography opportunities

Avoid: Major holidays (Chinese New Year, May Day, National Day) due to extreme crowds

Legend and Name Origin
"Legend says it was a heavenly elephant who fell in love with Guilin's beauty. When forced to return, it turned to stone while drinking from the river."

sources.content:
Elephant Trunk Hill, Guilin - Complete Text Content

Overview
Elephant Trunk Hill stands majestically in downtown Guilin at the junction of the Li River and Peach Blossom River. The name derives from its distinctive shape, resembling "a giant elephant dipping its trunk into the river." The formation combines with the green Li River waters to create one of Guilin's most iconic and photographed attractions.

Historical Background
Originally called "Li Hill," "Yi Hill," or "Chenshui Hill," this geological formation is 3.6 hundred million years old. The hill towers 55 meters above the Li River, measuring 108 meters in length and 100 meters in width, with an elevation of 200 meters above sea level. Elephant Trunk Hill earned recognition as "the symbol of Guilin."

Key Features and Attractions

Water Moon Cave (Shuiyue dong): Located riverside with Li River water flowing through it, this cave resembles "a full moon floating on the surface of the water with the moonlight reflected on the waves." Over 70 inscriptions from Tang and Song dynasties adorn the walls, celebrating the region's scenic beauty.

Puxian Pagoda: Standing atop the hill, this Ming dynasty structure (1368-1644) resembles a sword handle.

Elephant's Eye Stone: Positioned halfway up the hill, this cave tunnel represents the elephant's eyes and features numerous carvings and historical inscriptions, including poetry by Lu You (1125-1210), a renowned Southern Song dynasty poet.

Practical Information
Admission Pricing:
- 70 CNY per person (over 140 cm tall)
- 35 CNY per person (120-140 cm tall)
- Free admission (under 120 cm tall)

Contact Details:
- Phone: +86 773 289 8556
- Address: #1 Bingjiang Rd., Xiangshan, Guilin, Guangxi, China 541001
- Bus Routes: 2, 16, 23, 33, 57, 58

sources.title: Elephant Trunk Hill: Travel Tips & FAQs 2026
sources.content:
Elephant Trunk Hill: Travel Tips & FAQs 2026

Elephant Trunk Hill is an iconic elephant-shaped mountain renowned for its unique karst formation and picturesque Li River scenery. It is one of Guilin's most famous attractions and is free to visit.

Main Attractions: Key features include the Moon-in-the-Water Cave with millennia-old cliff carvings, the Puxian Pagoda (a Tibetan-style Buddhist pagoda at the summit offering panoramic views), and Elephant's Eye Cave with natural rock tunnel formations.

Visiting Information:
- Hours: 6:30 am - 9:30 pm in the summer; 7:00 am - 9:30 pm in the winter
- Entrance Fee: Approximately 75 CNY (around $11 USD) for adults and 37 CNY (around $5.50 USD) for children
- Difficulty Level: While the mountain isn't tall (approximately 200m elevation), the stone steps are steep with moderate hiking difficulty. It will take 20 minutes to climb to the top.

Best Times to Visit: Either in the early morning or late afternoon to avoid crowds and experience the hill bathed in soft light. It is recommended to visit during the autumn months of September to November.

Photography Tips: The Moon-in-the-Water viewing platform near Gate 2 offers the best angle to capture the classic shot of the "elephant's trunk" and the Li River.

sources.title: Elephant Trunk Hill - Landmark of Guilin Landscape
sources.content:
Elephant Trunk Hill - Landmark of Guilin Landscape

Elephant Trunk Hill serves as "a hot attraction and landmark of Guilin" with "beautiful natural views merged with valuable cultural landscape." The site represents one of Guilin's most recognizable geological formations.

The landmark features a distinctive elephant-shaped rock formation that has made it an iconic destination. The combination of natural scenery and cultural significance creates "a fascinating place which everyone longs for."

The hill is prominently featured in Guilin's tourism offerings and is recognized as a major attraction in Guangxi province.

sources.title: Guide to Guilin's Elephant Trunk Hill
sources.content:
Guide to Guilin's Elephant Trunk Hill

Elephant Trunk Hill is the symbol of Guilin and is considered as a must-visit for tourists in Guilin. This natural karst rock formation got its name for its particular shape resembling outstandingly like an elephant sucking water with its trunk into the pristine Li River.

The Moon-in-the-Water Cave features millennia-old cliff carvings where the elephant's "trunk" meets the Li River. The Puxian Pagoda is a Tibetan-style Buddhist pagoda at the summit offering panoramic views of Guilin and the Li River. The Elephant's Eye Cave is a natural rock tunnel visitors can walk through to witness fascinating geological formations.

During early morning hours (7:00-9:00), there are usually fewer crowds with soft lighting ideal for photography, and you might get the opportunity to observe locals practicing tai chi and morning exercises. Late afternoon (17:00-18:30) allows you to capture the sunset from the top of Elephant Trunk Hill.

It is suggested to take a picture of the Elephant Trunk Hill from a traditional bamboo raft that can be hired from the bank.

sources.title: 象山景区_百度百科
sources.content:
象山景区 - 百度百科

基本信息
象山景区位于广西壮族自治区桂林市，占地面积11.88万平方米。这是一个融合山水秀色的"多元化国际精品旅游景区"。

历史发展
宋代诗人张孝祥曾任广南西道经略安抚使，与桂林官员张维在水月洞边设宴，将凉亭命名为"朝阳亭"，并改洞名为"朝阳洞"。然而当地民众反对，南宋乾道九年（1173年）恢复了原名"水月洞"，此后沿用八百多年。

象山曾为古代兵家要地。明洪武元年（1368年），明将朱亮祖攻取桂林时曾屯兵于山下。清咸丰二年（1852年），太平军以云峰寺为指挥部、山顶为炮阵地，攻打桂林43天。1986年景区正式成立。

主要景点
象鼻山：原名漓山，因形似象鼻汲水而得名。1995年成为桂林城徽标志。
水月洞：位于象山东端，"洞高12米，宽9.5米，长17米"，保存22幅唐宋石刻，文字3065个，2015年获吉尼斯纪录。
普贤塔：始建于明代，高13.6米的喇嘛式砖塔。
其他景观：云峰寺、送子观音像、舍利塔、三花酒窖、爱情岛。

游览信息
- 门票：免费
- 旺季（4月-10月）：6:30-19:00
- 淡季（11月-3月）：7:00-18:30
- 评级：AAAAA级景区
- 交通：乘2、16、23路公交可达

所获荣誉
2003年被列为"世界旅游组织推荐游览景区"；2005年被评为"中国最美的五大峰林之首"；2017年获评国家AAAAA级旅游景区。

象鼻山门票信息

象鼻山景区自2024年3月1日起免费开放。游客可以通过景区官方预约入口进行预约。

开放时间：
- 淡季（12月-3月）：7:00-21:30
- 旺季（4月-11月）：6:30-21:30

景区地址：广西壮族自治区桂林市象山区民主路1号
交通：可乘坐2路、16路、23路到象山公园站下车

主要景点：象山水月、普贤宝塔、三花酒窖、爱情岛和云峰寺太平天国陈列馆等。

最佳旅游时间为四季皆宜，清晨可欣赏烟雨象鼻山，夜晚则可欣赏"象山水月"的夜景。建议首选步行上山，如果觉得累，可以选择乘竹筏穿越象鼻山的洞口。

sources.title: Elephant Trunk Hill, Guilin
sources.content:
Elephant Trunk Hill, Guilin

Elephant Trunk Hill is the symbol of Guilin. Most visitors spend about one hour in the park. While the mountain isn't tall (approximately 200m elevation), the stone steps are steep with moderate hiking difficulty; it will take 20 minutes to climb to the top.

Hours of Operation: Elephant Trunk Hill Park is open from 6:30 AM - 9:30 PM from April-November and 7:00 AM - 9:30 PM from December-March.

Transportation: Take city bus 2, 16, 23, Sightseeing Bus 1 and get off at Xiangshan Park Stop.

Puxian Pagoda is a Tibetan-style Buddhist pagoda at the summit offering panoramic views of Guilin and the Li River. Elephant's Eye Cave is a natural rock tunnel with fascinating geological formations.
